minor.issue: age_min=0 (or any falsy 0) passing — Pydantic accepts but clamp logic `incoming['age_min'] < 18` would catch it. However `_apply_advanced_filters_to_query` uses `if age_min or age_max:` so a saved age_min=0 (impossible after clamp) would be ignored. Edge case is benign because clamp runs first, but the falsy-check pattern is fragile — prefer `is not None`.
distance_max clamp is one-sided (<1 → 1) but no upper bound. A user could save distance_max=999999 and post-filter would do a noop comparison. Consider clamping to 500 (the UI max) to keep DB clean.

must_have_personality_dna=False is persisted because `exclude_none=True` keeps False. Discover query only checks `if f.get('must_have_personality_dna')` (truthy) so False is a no-op — correct behaviour, but the DB will accumulate `must_have_personality_dna: false` entries that have no effect. Either strip falsy booleans on save or document.

Uses ISO-string comparison for `last_active >= cutoff.isoformat()` — works because both sides are UTC ISO strings, but mixing string sort with datetime is fragile. Prefer storing+querying BSON datetimes (same observation as iter10).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3841 lines — split is more overdue than ever. Filters logic (~190 lines from 2151-2350) is a perfect router extraction candidate: /app/backend/routers/filters.py.

ADVANCED_FILTER_OPTIONS is defined AFTER the /options/profile-fields endpoint (line 2143 references constant at line 2153). Works in Python because route handlers are closures evaluated at request time, but the ordering is confusing — move the constant block above the endpoint, or define endpoints after all constants.

FilterPreferences model has 18 fields — consider splitting into BaseFilters (free) and AdvancedFilters (premium) Pydantic models with a discriminator or composition. This would let FastAPI auto-document the gating in OpenAPI.
FREE_FILTER_KEYS is a set but ADVANCED_FILTER_KEYS is a list — pick one type for consistency.

_apply_advanced_filters_to_query mutates `query` in-place (side effect). Pure-function style returning a query dict would be more testable and avoid the recently-spotted `query['$and']` accumulation bug pattern.
Discover endpoint applies filters AFTER profile_complete + gender mapping but BEFORE compatibility scoring + distance — correct ordering for performance (filter first, score last). Good.

FiltersPage.jsx (299 lines) is fine size-wise; MultiSelect + NumRange + locked indicator pattern is clean. Consider extracting filter sections into a config-driven render (single map call) since 11 MultiSelects are nearly identical JSX — could shrink to ~150 lines.
DELETE /api/me/filters uses {$unset: {filters: ''}} — idempotent and clean. Good.
No rate limiting on PUT /api/me/filters — a malicious client could spam saves. Consider 1-call-per-second debounce or relying on existing API rate-limit middleware.
